jess-support: Hey team — customer Nimbus Health is going live tomorrow 09:00 PT and just asked for a temporary increase in hosted concurrency. Their expected traffic is spiky: ~450 concurrent streams and bursts to 1.2k rps for short windows. They filed ticket INC-2026. Can we do a quota exception? Need answer within 3h. 

mike-sre: @jess-support what's their current quota and which model/route? and do we have a prepared fallback? 

jess-support: Current quota: 120 concurrency, route: /v1/generate (gpt-open-8k). They'll accept routing to a smaller model but worried about latency/quality. Prefers to avoid rejection. 

lauren-infra: infra note — cluster in us-west2 currently at 82% GPU saturation during peak. Autoscaler can spin up capacity but provisioning time is ~45–60m for burst nodes. Manual temporary quota bump possible but will pull from pool shared with other hosted customers. 

infra-bot: ALERT: queue_length(/v1/generate)=310, avg_latency=420ms, admission_drop_rate=0.06 :warning: 

mike-sre: If we just bump concurrency without extra GPUs we'll see queueing/backpressure. Options: 1) short manual GPU burst (add 60 GPUs for 3h) 2) route a % of traffic to smaller quantized model + enable aggressive prefix caching 3) apply token-level rate-limit + 503-on-overflow with Retry-After header. Which does sales prefer? 

ev an-sales: Customer will tolerate slightly lower quality for first 2 hours, but SLA requires <2% error. They want minimal 5 minute tail latencies. Cost is fine for a paid burst, they asked for estimate. 

lauren-infra: Cost estimate: manual burst (60 A10Gs) ~ $14k for 3h (infra margin included). We can do staged ramp: add 20 GPUs now, then +40 at T+30m after health checks. Risk: other customers may see slightly higher tail latencies during ramp. 

aj-oncall: add monitoring dashboards and an alert runbook link. I'll be on-call during the window. Can we also enable admission control to shed low-priority traffic? 

mike-sre: I'll prepare a temporary admission-control policy: 

```
route: /v1/generate
priority: high -> 100% pass
           medium -> 30% pass
           low -> 0% pass (503)
burst-duration: 3h
```

This will reduce queue growth. Need ops approval to run manual burst. 

jess-support: ok filing formal request: INC-2026-BURST. Start window requested 2026-03-22 09:00 PT. Approve? :pray: 

lauren-infra: Approved pending payment confirmation. I'll kick off +20 GPUs now, will post updates. 

mike-sre: I'll deploy the admission-control policy and set Retry-After=30s for dropped requests. aj-oncall please verify dashboards. 

aj-oncall: will monitor; will DM if we see emergent errors. 

ev an-sales: I'll get the customer's purchase order and confirm payment. 

jess-support: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and close the loop once they confirm PO.
